correctness.rationale: For Sigma_d={x:||x||_1+||x||_infty<=1}, the exact support maximization over signed k-support vertices is H=max_{1<=k<=d} S_k/(k+1). Equivalently, F_d(H)=sum_i(|G_i|-H)_+-H=0, and the exposed support rank is N_d(H). The half-normal excess integrals yield t_d^2=2 log d-3 log log d-log(4 pi)+o(1), d p(t_d)/t_d^2->1, d E(Y-t_d)_+^2->2, and d E(Y-t_d)_+^2=d p(t_d)-t_d^2. A triangular-array CLT for the centered excess sum B and count A gives covariance [[2,1],[1,1]]; uniform local tail counts show t_d^2(H-t_d)=B+o_P(1), (K-t_d^2)/t_d=A-B+o_P(1), giving joint covariance [[2,-1],[-1,1]]. Radial G/||G|| normalization is o_P(1) on that scale; UI of H/t_d gives mean width equivalent. Reconstructed boundary d>=2 and asymptotic only; independent quadrature checked exact moment identity at d=1000,10000,100000. Finite checks do not prove asymptotic convergence.
